## 17 - EGX AI Assessment

User-requested addition beyond the original spec: a language model's own read on that day's Top 10 (overall_rank <= 10, eligible only — never the full 241-stock universe, to keep this cheap: ~10 API calls/day). For each pick, asks Claude (via the Anthropic Messages API, forced tool-use for structured output) for (1) its own probability estimate that Target 1 is reached within target1_estimated_days, and (2) a 0-100 conviction score used to derive ai_rank — a SECOND ranking of the same Top 10, shown alongside overall_rank, never replacing it.

Deliberately distinct from BOTH other probability signals already in this project: target1_estimated_days (a rough ATR-based arithmetic projection) and historical_target1_hit_pct (a measured historical rate from 16-egx-target-window-evaluation). This one is a model's judgment call from limited technical data — not a statistic, not a guarantee — labeled 'AI Assessment' everywhere it's surfaced (see docs/SCORING.md).

Requires ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (env var, real secret — never committed). If unset or invalid, every row simply gets no AI columns (NULL) rather than the workflow failing — see 'Has Assessment?' below.

Called by 12 after 11 (fan-out, not blocking the report step). Can also run standalone via Manual Trigger for the latest date.

parameters.query:
SELECT r.id AS scanner_result_id, s.symbol, s.name, r.setup_type, r.overall_rank,
       r.overall_score::float8 AS overall_score,
       r.breakout_score::float8 AS breakout_score, r.momentum_score::float8 AS momentum_score,
       r.pullback_score::float8 AS pullback_score, r.reversal_score::float8 AS reversal_score,
       ta.rsi14::float8 AS rsi14, ta.macd_histogram::float8 AS macd_histogram,
       ta.short_term_trend, ta.medium_term_trend, ta.long_term_trend,
       r.entry_price::float8 AS entry_price, r.target1::float8 AS target1,
       r.invalidation_price::float8 AS invalidation_price,
       r.target1_gain_pct::float8 AS target1_gain_pct,
       r.target1_estimated_days, r.risk_reward_t1::float8 AS risk_reward_t1,
       ps.target1_hit_pct::float8 AS historical_target1_hit_pct,
       ps.stop_hit_pct::float8 AS historical_stop_hit_pct,
       ps.sample_size AS historical_sample_size
FROM scanner_results r
JOIN stocks s ON s.id = r.stock_id
JOIN scanner_runs run ON run.id = r.scanner_run_id
LEFT JOIN technical_analysis ta ON ta.stock_id = r.stock_id AND ta.trading_date = run.trading_date
LEFT JOIN probability_stats ps ON ps.setup_type = r.setup_type AND ps.market = run.market
WHERE r.scanner_run_id = (SELECT id FROM scanner_run_as_of($1, $2))
  AND r.overall_rank <= 10 AND r.eligible = TRUE
ORDER BY r.overall_rank ASC;

UPDATE scanner_results
SET ai_target1_probability_pct = $2, ai_stop_probability_pct = $3, ai_rank_score = $4, ai_rank = $5,
    ai_reasoning = $6, ai_assessed_at = now()
WHERE id = $1;
